turns.text: We can't agree on how to sleep on our camping trip, so help me decide.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to describe each one. Save your comments until the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option one is our old dome tent, which is free but leaks a little when it rains.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option two is renting a small cabin at the campground for about sixty dollars a night.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's sleeping in the back of the van with a mattress, which my brother swears by.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or finally, we buy a brand new tent, which is maybe two hundred dollars.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The cabin is the safest bet if rain is likely, and over a weekend it costs less than a new tent. If you camp often, though, buying the new tent pays off quickly.
